answer: Every new agent locks a refundable 240 POA deposit for 100 days before trading, so each fake identity costs 240 POA parked for over three months. Before it unlocks, the agent must finish a live job while three auditors picked by lottery watch the pulse of its decisions in real time. The auditors also flag any agent whose trail can wander across unrelated markets no real operator would touch. If they catch copied behavior, the deposit burns into the tundra reserve and the identity is frozen.
